document_check.note: Xu Y, Zhang Z, Peng J, Li X, Xu Y, Song Q, Shu Z, Xie Y. Use of magnetic resonance structural imaging to identify disease progression in patients with mild cognitive impairment: A voxel-based morphometry and surface-based morphometry study. Neuroscience 579 (2025) 382-389. ADNI (154 MCI: 62 pMCI, 92 sMCI) with NACC external set (51). Matches Xu et al. 2025.

cited_result: Baseline VBM (CAT12) grey matter volume reduction, including the right hippocampus and left middle temporal gyrus, in 62 MCI patients who progressed to AD over four years compared with 92 who remained stable (ADNI), which is the part of the paper supporting 'hippocampal and medial-temporal atrophy in MCI ... reproduced across voxel-based morphometry'.
tool_reason: The cited result is the association of a baseline structural measure (regional grey matter volume) with later progression to AD, a prognostic-factor question, not the performance of the logistic 'index' models and not a single-time-point comparison with controls.

domains.rationale: Eligibility required complete four-year follow-up and complete data, and excluded reverters. The source ADNI population, sampling frame, phases, period and the number screened are not described, so how the 154 were chosen from the eligible pool is unknown. Baseline characteristics are reported.

signalling.question: Is the source population and the sampling frame and recruitment adequately described?
signalling.quote: Detailed information on the inclusion and exclusion criteria can be found in the ADNI protocol. [Searched for: ADNI phases, dates, number of eligible MCI participants, selection procedure; none reported.]

signalling.question: Are inclusion and exclusion criteria adequately described?
signalling.quote: The inclusion criteria were as follows: all patients had an initial diagnosis of MCI and a four-year follow-up; all patients underwent 3D T1WI and had complete clinical information.

signalling.question: Is the baseline study sample adequately described?
signalling.quote: there were no significant differences between the two groups in age, sex, or duration of education (P > 0.05), and there were significant differences in APOE4 levels, CDRS scores, ADAS scores, and MOCA scores (p < 0.05).

domains.rationale: Participants without four-year follow-up were excluded by design, so attrition is hidden rather than reported. The number lost and the characteristics of those lost compared with completers are not given.

signalling.question: Is the proportion of the baseline sample available for analysis, and reasons for loss, reported?
signalling.quote: all patients had an initial diagnosis of MCI and a four-year follow-up [Searched for: number of MCI participants excluded for incomplete follow-up, comparison of completers and non-completers; none reported.]

signalling.question: Were those lost to follow-up compared with those retained?
signalling.quote: [Searched for: any comparison of excluded and included participants; none.]

domains.rationale: A standard automated CAT12/SPM12 pipeline was applied identically to all baseline T1 images, so the measurement is not influenced by outcome status. Acquisition details are deferred to supplementary material, which was not available.

signalling.question: Is the prognostic factor measured in a valid and reliable way, and in the same way for all participants?
signalling.quote: processing steps strictly followed the CAT12 user manual prepared by Gaser and Kurth

domains.rationale: Progression to AD over four years is the outcome, but no diagnostic criteria, ascertainment procedure or assessor blinding are described. The limitations paragraph describes the study as 'not a longitudinal study', which leaves the timing of outcome ascertainment unclear.

signalling.question: Is a clear definition of the outcome provided, and is the method of measurement valid and reliable?
signalling.quote: of these, 62 experienced cognitive progression to AD over the four-year follow-up period. [Searched for: AD diagnostic criteria, who diagnosed conversion; not reported.]

signalling.question: Is the outcome measured in the same way for all participants and over an appropriate period?
signalling.quote: First, this study focused mainly on the difference between MCI progression and stability; however, it was not a longitudinal study

domains.rationale: The VBM comparison adjusted for age, sex and whole-brain volume. Scanner, site and field strength in multi-site ADNI data are not addressed, and education is not included, although the groups were similar on it.

signalling.question: Are important potential confounders measured and accounted for in the analysis?
signalling.quote: the cortical volume of different brain regions of each patient was extracted, and age, sex, and whole-brain volume were used as covariates

signalling.question: Are scanner or site effects accounted for?
signalling.quote: [Searched for: scanner, site, field strength, harmonisation; not reported in the main text.]

domains.rationale: The whole-brain voxelwise VBM analysis reports no threshold or multiple-comparison correction, so it cannot be judged whether the hippocampal cluster survives correction. No effect size or statistic is given for the hippocampus in the main text (Table S1 only). The authors relaxed SBM thresholds to uncorrected p < 0.05 after corrected analyses were null, showing flexible thresholding. The NACC group counts are reported inconsistently.

signalling.question: Is the statistical analysis adequately described, including control of multiple testing?
signalling.quote: The statistical module of SPM12 was used to compare the volume of the progression of the brain area of interest with that of the nonprogressive brain regions; finally, the brain regions with volume differences were obtained

signalling.question: Is there no evidence of selective reporting or flexible analysis?
signalling.quote: no significant differences were found between the sMCI group and the pMCI group in terms of cortical depth or cortical fractal dimension after FDR correction. Therefore, we chose a more relaxed statistical method (uncorrected at p < 0.05).

signalling.question: Are sufficient data presented to assess the result?
signalling.quote: These regions showed a significant decrease in gray matter volume in the pMCI group compared to the sMCI group. ... Detailed information on these differences can be found in Table S1 of the supplementary materials.

applicability.rationale: The study has no cognitively normal controls. Its hippocampal finding is a within-MCI contrast (progressive against stable), not the MCI-versus-control atrophy the review's sentence summarises.
ADNI and NACC research cohorts, restricted to participants who completed four years of follow-up and did not revert.

overall: High risk of bias (QUIPS: participation moderate, attrition moderate, prognostic factor measurement low, outcome measurement moderate, confounding moderate, statistical analysis and reporting high)
overall_rationale: One domain is high (undisclosed correction for the voxelwise VBM comparison, with post hoc threshold relaxation elsewhere), and four domains are moderate. Under the review's QUIPS rule either condition gives an overall high rating.
